implementation_assumptions.head: Linear(64,1), bias=True, no output activation
implementation_assumptions.loss: negative Pearson correlation across one date; centered score and label; denominator clamp 1e-8
implementation_assumptions.validation_metric: equal-weight mean negative Pearson IC over weekly validation dates
implementation_assumptions.normalization: train-only median and 1.4826*MAD over all training sequence elements; scale floor1e-6; clip[-5,5]
implementation_assumptions.mask: raw A >= arithmetic median / raw A < arithmetic median; zero complete input row; retain all20 time steps
implementation_assumptions.date_order: numpy generator(seed=2026) shuffles training dates each epoch
implementation_assumptions.batch: one complete weekly cross-section, dynamic number of stocks
implementation_assumptions.output_sign: positive IC optimization, no OOS sign flip
implementation_assumptions.missing_window_policy: 20 consecutive market trading dates; require all inputs finite and positive volume on every date; do not replace missing values with zero
